occurrences.text: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
